description: Edit an AppLovin creative set, read back: rename it, change its countries or languages (an empty list means all), its landing page (url; "" falls back to the campaign’s), replace its assets (assetIds, checked against AppLovin’s own asset types first), or add it to more campaigns (addToCampaignIds, up to 20). Adding a LIVE set to a LIVE campaign needs confirm:true. Status is set_applovin_ads_status. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

addToCampaignIds.description: also run it in these campaigns (up to 20)

brandInfo.description: override the account brand on THIS creative set — how a brand A/B tests the end card

confirm.description: required to add a LIVE set to a LIVE campaign

creativeSetId.description: AppLovin creative set id to edit

url.description: landing page for this set; "" = the campaign’s

useAccountBrandInfo.description: true = go back to the account-level brand info

name: update_applovin_ads_creative_set
title: Edit an AppLovin creative set
